text:
marta: Drafting release notes for 2.13.0 — runtime perf + routing-fallback improvements. Need quick eyes from ops/docs/legal today so I can pin and schedule the deploy. Pin target: 2024-12-20 16:00 PT. Deploy window: 2024-12-21 00:00-04:00 UTC. Who can run final smoke? Any embargo/locale flags for APAC/EU? :spiral_calendar:
rachel: Docs nit — please use the phrase "version pin (artifact SHA)" in the customer-facing bit and add a one-line compatibility note about the `truncate` default for compact models. Also include a short curl example.
sam: Ops: add explicit rollback thresholds and the revert tag. Suggest: rollback if client error rate > 1.6% sustained for 7m OR p95 token latency increases >180ms for 10m. Revert tag: `revert/2.13.0`. Include the exact revert commands in the runbook.
devops: I can run smoke for US 00:00-02:00 UTC and coordinate APAC checks with oncall there. Smoke checklist: health endpoints, 4 gen prompts (short/long/edge), 3 embedding samples, KV cache warmup, routing-fallback test to regional variant. If smoke fails I will hit `revert/2.13.0` and notify ops-rotation.
docs-bot: NOTE: Draft link posted — https://docs.internal/releases/2.13.0-draft. Added curl snippet and wording tweak.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary plan uploaded: 5% -> 25% -> 75% -> 100% with 12m ramps. Auto-rollback if canary error delta > 1.25% OR p95 latency delta > 160ms vs baseline. Preview: `/deploy start v2.13.0 --canary=5,25,75 --ramp=12m --annotations="internal-announce:pending,ops-runbook:attached"`
marta: Added the revert tag and rollback steps to the draft, plus Dedicated FAQ line about quiesce and pinned artifact example. Draft link: https://docs.internal/releases/2.13.0-draft (please comment inline).
rachel: LGTMs on content from docs. Tiny tweak: change "scheduled quiesce" to "brief quiesce during model swap (~5m)".
sam: I will draft the internal-announce snippet and set it to autopost when canary hits 25% so oncall has time to escalate. Will include exact ping list and runbook bullets.
devops: Copy — will run smoke and paste logs here. If APAC routing fallback shows regressions, I will revert and escalate. Rollback procedure: `git tag -f current && /deploy rollback revert/2.13.0` (runbook has full steps).
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: Deploy scheduled to start 2024-12-21T00:00:00Z. Manifest `manifest-2.13.0.json` attached. Canary annotations saved (internal announce at 25%).
marta: OK planning to pin draft at 2024-12-20 16:00 PT unless any objections. I will set deploybot annotation to `internal-announce:pending` so comms autoposts at the 25% canary step. Please thumbs up when done reviewing.
rachel: :thumbsup: docs sign-off.
sam: :thumbsup: comms ready, will localize quick lines for EU/APAC.
devops: :thumbsup: ready for smoke run.
marta: Pinned. Ill flip the annotation before start and monitor canary steps. If anything odd, devops/sam will trigger `revert/2.13.0` and broadcast to ops-rotation.
